title: Daniel All Access
description: “ENIGMA” is the name of this presentation, based on the 5th chapter in the book of Daniel.  These are the closing scenes of the Neo-Babylon empire.  Belshazzar was the king, and hours away from the end of his life, an enigma is presented to him in the form of mysterious writing on the wall.  Once again Daniel is called to decipher the time-sensitive code message from the Lord.

title: Final Days International: Mission Reports
description: Inherited faith is one thing; finding truth for yourself is another. Jay, a pastor's son, didn't come expecting to change. He walked into one of India's Sunday-pastor seminars and heard Daniel and Revelation explained in a way he'd never encountered before. Hearing his personal testimony, alongside other stories of people who were stunned by the message, is evidence that the gospel work is alive and well.
